_note: The Greyfold, levels 3-5: farmland east of Harrowgate. See docs/zones.md.

east_gate.name: The East Gate
east_gate.description: A squat gatehouse in the city wall. The East Road runs out of it towards the farms of the Greyfold.

features.gate: Iron-bound oak, open from dawn to dusk and most of the night too. Someone has chalked a crude red cap on the arch.

gf_road.name: The East Road
gf_road.description: A rutted road between high hedges, east out of Harrowgate. Cart tracks, and a lot of them lately turned back.

gf_milestone.name: The Crow Milestone
gf_milestone.description: An old milestone, black with crows.

features.milestone: Carved: HARROWGATE I · MILLBROOK III. Crows have made it theirs.

gf_crossroads.name: Greyfold Crossroads
gf_crossroads.description: Four roads meet at a leaning signpost.

features.signpost: North: THE HOLLOW (someone has scratched REDCAPS under it). East: THE FALLOW FIELDS. South-east: MILLBROOK.

gf_hollow_path.name: The Hollow Path
gf_hollow_path.description: A sunken lane, hedged in so deep it's dusk at noon. It climbs north into Redcap Hollow.

mb_lane.name: Millbrook Lane
mb_lane.description: The lane into Millbrook, past a pond full of ducks and a smell of bread.

mb_mill.name: Fenwick's Mill
mb_mill.description: The mill wheel turns, the stones grind, and flour hangs in the air.

features.wheel: It creaks. It has always creaked.

mb_green.name: Millbrook Green
mb_green.description: A village green with a maypole and a well. Everyone here knows everyone.

features.well: Cold and deep. A bucket on a rope.
features.maypole: Ribbons faded to the colour of old tea.

mb_inn.name: The Stoat & Barrel
mb_inn.description: A low, smoky inn with a fire that never goes out. Goodwife Ama keeps it.

features.fire: Warm enough to sleep beside, and people do.

mb_tannery.name: Cobb's Tannery
mb_tannery.description: Hides on frames, pits of things you don't want to smell. Cobb doesn't notice any more.

features.frames: Wolf, fox, deer. A gap where the next wolf pelts should go.

mb_reeve.name: The Reeve's House
mb_reeve.description: A tidy house with a ledger on every surface. Reeve Halden runs Millbrook from here.

features.ledger: Carts robbed: seven this month. The last entry is underlined twice.

mb_fen_lane.name: Fen Lane
mb_fen_lane.description: A lane south out of Millbrook, getting wetter with every step. The fens are that way.

ff_edge.name: The Field's Edge
ff_edge.description: Fields gone to seed, and a hedge with a gap in it.

ff_scarecrow.name: The Scarecrow Field
ff_scarecrow.description: A scarecrow in a red cap. Someone thinks that's funny.

features.scarecrow: The cap is a real Redcap's. The crows aren't fooled.

ff_ditch.name: The Drainage Ditch
ff_ditch.description: A deep ditch of black water. Rust-red lumps show in the banks.

features.banks: Bog iron: the smiths' cheap ore, if you dig for it.

ff_orchard.name: The Old Orchard
ff_orchard.description: Gnarled apple trees, the ground under them rooted up and wrecked.

ff_hedge.name: The Hedge Gap
ff_hedge.description: A gap in the hedge. North of it, the trees of Bramblewood.

bw_edge.name: Bramblewood Edge
bw_edge.description: Brambles as high as a horse, and paths through them only wolves made.

bw_thicket.name: The Thicket
bw_thicket.description: Thorns snag at everything. Tufts of grey fur on the thorns.

bw_glade.name: Fox Glade
bw_glade.description: A small clearing where the light gets in. Bones under the ferns.

bw_den.name: The Wolf Den
bw_den.description: A hollow under a fallen oak, stinking of wolf. Something big sleeps here.

rh_camp.name: Redcap Camp
rh_camp.description: A bandit camp in a hollow: a cookfire, stolen barrels, and a lot of red caps.

features.barrels: Millbrook ale, by the brand. All of it.

rh_lookout.name: The Lookout
rh_lookout.description: A rock above the camp where a Redcap watches the road.

rh_tent.name: Mags Redcap's Tent
rh_tent.description: A big tent of stolen sailcloth. Mags Redcap's, and everyone knows it.

features.chest: Locked, and heavy with other people's money.

bk_foot.name: Knoll Foot
bk_foot.description: The foot of a grassy knoll with standing stones on top. A path winds up.

bk_top.name: Barrow Knoll
bk_top.description: Standing stones round a barrow mound. The entrance gapes, and a cold air comes out of it.

features.stones: Worn faces, all looking at the entrance.

bk_passage.name: The Barrow Passage
bk_passage.description: A low stone passage, sloping down.

bk_hall.name: The Burial Hall
bk_hall.description: Niches of bones along both walls. Some niches are empty.

bk_crypt.name: The Crypt
bk_crypt.description: A chieftain's tomb, its lid pushed aside from inside. A pale light burns here.

bog_iron.name: lump of bog iron
bog_iron.description: A rust-red lump of bog iron, heavier than it looks.

grave_lantern.name: grave lantern
grave_lantern.description: A bronze lantern with a pale flame that gives no heat.

halden.name: Reeve Halden
halden.label: Reeve
halden.description: careworn, with ink on his fingers
halden.details: Careworn, with ink on his fingers.

topics.work: Work? The Redcaps are robbing every cart on the road. Ask me about the Redcaps if you've a stomach for it.
topics.ale: The ale stopped because the Redcaps took the last three carts. They camp in the Hollow, north of the crossroads. Tell Marta that.

redcaps.text: Four of them, and Mags Redcap, who leads them. Bring them down and the road's open again. The Hollow is north of the crossroads.

topics.mags: Mags was a drover once. Now she's the worst of them.
topics.fen: South of here the land goes to fen. Sister Odile keeps a chapel out there. Mad, or holy, or both.
topics.moor: North of the Hollow the land goes up onto Gallows Moor. The Wardens have a camp at the stone circle. Don't cross it at night.
topics.place: Millbrook's a small place with large ledgers. Somebody has to keep them.

background.text: Reeve for twelve years. Before that, a clerk. Before that, a soldier, if you'll believe it.

lure.sense: {Where}, the scratch of a pen, and someone sighing over a ledger.
lure.rumour: Reeve Halden in Millbrook has trouble with the Redcaps.

greet.first: Reeve Halden. Do you have business with Millbrook?

wants.says: Bring me their caps, and the village pays a bounty. Three apiece.

ama.name: Goodwife Ama
ama.label: Innkeeper
ama.description: round and red-cheeked, with a ladle
ama.details: Round and red-cheeked, with a ladle.

topics.work: Lights on Barrow Knoll at night, that's what worries me. Ask me about the lights.

lights.text: Pale lights on the knoll after dark, and the Partridge boy came back white as milk. Take a torch into that barrow and see what's woken. Bring me something to show it's done.

topics.knoll: South-west of the green. The barrow's on top. Nobody goes in.
topics.place: The Stoat & Barrel. Ale, stew and a bed. What more is there?
topics.rumours: There are lights on Barrow Knoll at night. Nobody goes up there any more. Nobody sensible.

lure.sense: {Where}, woodsmoke and stew from a busy inn.
lure.rumour: Goodwife Ama at the Stoat & Barrel has seen lights on the knoll.

greet.first: Welcome to the Stoat & Barrel, love.

wants.says: Boar, for the pot. Three a haunch.

cobb.name: Cobb
cobb.label: Tanner
cobb.description: leathery, and so is his apron
cobb.details: Leathery, and so is his apron.

topics.work: I need wolf pelts. Ask me about pelts.

pelts.text: Five good pelts from the Bramblewood wolves, north past the Fallow Fields. Bring me five and I'll make you something warm.

topics.mother: The old she-wolf in the den. Bigger than a pony, and clever. Kill her and the pack scatters.
topics.place: Millbrook. Quiet, mostly. The wolves are the only noise.

lure.sense: {Where}, the sour reek of tanning pits.
lure.rumour: Cobb the tanner pays well for pelts.

greet.first: Cobb. Tanner. You'll get used to the smell.

wants.says: Wolf pelts, always. Four a pelt. More if they're whole, which they never are.

items.thanks: Not bad. Not bad at all.

topics.work: The boars are in my orchard. Ask me about the orchard.

orchard.text: Four wild boars, rooting up the orchard east of the Fallow Fields. Mind their charge: you can't stop it, only get out of the way.

topics.place: Millbrook mill. My grandfather built the wheel, and it's never stopped.

lure.sense: {Where}, the creak and splash of a mill wheel.
lure.rumour: Fenwick the miller's at his wits' end with the boars.

greet.first: Fenwick, the miller. Mind the flour.

redcap_1.name: Redcap Cutthroat
redcap_1.label: Bandit
redcap_1.description: a bandit in a red cap
redcap_1.details: A bandit in a red cap.

redcap_2.label: Bandit
redcap_2.description: a bandit in a red cap

redcap_3.name: Redcap Cutthroat
redcap_3.label: Bandit
redcap_3.description: a bandit in a red cap
redcap_3.details: A bandit in a red cap.

mags_redcap.name: Mags Redcap
mags_redcap.label: Bandit Chief
mags_redcap.description: a big woman in a bigger red cap, with a cudgel
mags_redcap.details: A big woman in a bigger red cap, with a cudgel.

barrow_ghoul_1.name: Barrow Ghoul
barrow_ghoul_1.label: Ghoul
barrow_ghoul_1.description: a grey, starved thing that was a man
barrow_ghoul_1.details: A grey, starved thing that was a man.

barrow_ghoul_2.name: Barrow Ghoul
barrow_ghoul_2.label: Ghoul
barrow_ghoul_2.description: a grey, starved thing that was a man
barrow_ghoul_2.details: A grey, starved thing that was a man.

barrow_wight.name: the Barrow-Wight
barrow_wight.label: Wight
barrow_wight.description: a crowned corpse with a pale fire in its eyes
barrow_wight.details: A crowned corpse with a pale fire in its eyes.

greyfold_billhook.name: Greyfold Billhook
greyfold_billhook.description: Brannoc's work: a farmer's billhook with a fighting edge. Good in a mild breeze.

redcap_knife.name: Redcap Knife
redcap_knife.description: Mags Redcap's own knife: thin, quick and nasty. The cut keeps bleeding.

wolfskin_hood.name: Wolfskin Hood
wolfskin_hood.description: Cobb's work, from Bramblewood pelts. Warm, and a little fierce. +1 Vigor.

barrow_lantern.name: Barrow Lantern
barrow_lantern.description: The grave lantern, cleansed by Goodwife Ama's priest. Its pale flame steadies you. +1 Resilience.

outlaws.name: The Outlaws
outlaws.description: Redcaps, highwaymen and worse. They respect a hard fight and hate an informer.

rules.note: They won't forget it, but they respect a fighter.
You ran from them. They'll tell everyone.

tavern.goal: You've reached Alzendor. Harrowgate's tavern is the place to find work: go there.

ask.goal: Ask the innkeeper about work: DISCUSS WORK WITH MARTA.
Millbrook's ale has stopped coming. Go east out of the East Gate to Millbrook (south-east at the crossroads) and DISCUSS ALE WITH HALDEN.

back.goal: Take the news back to Marta: DISCUSS REDCAPS WITH MARTA.

effects.text: Marta sighs. "Redcaps. Of course. Well, now you know where the work is."

get.goal: Brannoc wants bog iron from the drainage ditch in the Fallow Fields (east at the Greyfold crossroads): GET IRON.

give.goal: Bring it to Brannoc in his smithy: GIVE IRON TO BRANNOC.

effects.text: Brannoc grins and gets to work. By evening he hands you a billhook, still warm.

hunt.goal: Cobb wants five wolf pelts. Hunt the wolves of Bramblewood (north through the hedge gap in the Fallow Fields).

back.goal: Back to Cobb's tannery in Millbrook: DISCUSS PELTS WITH COBB.

effects.say: Good pelts. Here: I made this from the last lot.

gf_wolfmother.name: The Wolf Mother

kill.goal: The pack will be back while the Wolf Mother lives. She dens at the far end of Bramblewood. Her maul can be blocked: watch for it.

back.goal: Tell Cobb: DISCUSS MOTHER WITH COBB.

gf_wolfmother.offer: But the pack'll be back while the Wolf Mother lives. She dens at the far end of Bramblewood. Would you kill her for me? Then they'll scatter.
gf_wolfmother.accepted: Watch her maul. It'll break a shield arm.

kill.goal: Kill four wild boars in the Fallow Fields' orchard. Their charge can be dodged, not blocked.

back.goal: Tell Fenwick at the mill: DISCUSS ORCHARD WITH FENWICK.

band.goal: Thin out the Redcaps in Redcap Hollow (north of the crossroads): four of them.

mags.goal: Now Mags Redcap, in her tent. Block the cudgel.

back.goal: Tell Reeve Halden: DISCUSS MAGS WITH HALDEN.

effects.text: Halden writes it in his ledger and underlines it twice. "The road's open. Take this: it was hers."

reputation.note: The Greyfold's road is open again.

wight.goal: Take a torch into the barrow on Barrow Knoll (south-west of Millbrook green, then DOWN), and put down whatever's woken.

get.goal: In the crypt, the pale lantern still burns: GET LANTERN.

back.goal: Bring it to Goodwife Ama at the inn: GIVE LANTERN TO AMA.

effects.text: Ama has the priest bless it, and hands it back. "Its light is clean now. Keep it."
